To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1/ the use of EPI in environmental management is more complex than it seems, and 2/ it is not a simple matter to identify the environmental management control system from the environmental performance indicators.

the environmental performance indicators (IPE) are used for two distinct purposes : external communication (IPE) and internal management (IPE) ; that these uses are not mutually exclusive ; that the IPE are used for two different purposes : communication and management ; that the I PE are used for two purposes, communication and management ; and that the IPE used for management purposes are more numerous than the IPE used only for communication purposes ; that the I EPI used for management purposes and the I
- EPI systems are not only a communication tool but also a control tool, and that they are used in a way that is not necessarily coherent with their objectives.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the analysis of the environmental performance indicators in a context of environmental management control.
the study of the interactions between two systems of representation, and the role of the EPIs in this process.
the study of the environmental performance representation in a company and the associated environmental management control.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the environmental performance is a representation of the environmental impact of a company, that is to say a representation of its environmental performance.
the EPIs are a useful and necessary tool for the management of a company's environmental performance, but that they are not a sufficient tool.

the use of environmental indicators is a process of representation of the environment in the company, which can be seen as a system of environmental performance indicators, and that this system is composed of two sub-systems, one external, one internal, which have different functions, and which are in a relation of complementarity.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the use of environmental indicators in a system of environmental performance communication is not the same as the use of these indicators in a system for environmental performance control.

the EPI, as a communication tool, can be used to improve the image of a company in front of the public, and that the EPI as a management control tool can be used to control the company environmental management.
the environmental performance indicators, in the case of chemical companies, are used to control the environmental management, and not as an environmental communication tool.
The main takeaway from our work is that
these two systems are not necessarily linked and that they are not necessarily complementary.
the use of the EPI in a company is not only a question of technical choices, but also a matter of social and cultural choices.
the use of the EPI is a process that depends on the context, and that the use of these tools is a complex process, which involves a large number of actors and a variety of tools.
